events.title: Demo update: boss encounters, movement, scenery and UI
events.summary: The latest Spirestorm demo update focuses on making the climb easier to read: learn each opponent's rhythm, keep your bearings as the tower scrolls, and spot the opening before committing to a strike. Boss encounters and practice All ten guardians and ten minibosses now have distinct attack phrases, encounter dialogue and phase-change cues. Counters are tied to each fight's mechanics: break conductors, return charged root pulses, interrupt bell tolls or sabotage forge arms to create an opening.
